doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: Closing audio quiz with John Pizzarelli and goodbyes
summary: A last audio clip turns out to be John and Bucky Live at the Vineyard; Ruth invites everyone to supper.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay well this has just been really very interesting for me. And one last thing, see if you remember where this came from.
That’s you, and some other guitar player you know.
Keep in on. Keep it on yet. Keep it on, yeah. Put it up a little.
There’s no drum on that, you’re right.
“John and Bucky Live at the Vineyard.”
Oh that was a long time ago.
John was still in his yout. Anyway, we feel privileged to be in your house.
Well I’m going to get — are you ready to have supper?
We are, and thank you very much.
Oh you’re quite welcome. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
